headline: Ruined Strongholds Rise Again as Stlican Shelf Turns Fiercest
war_summary: Three strongholds that lay in ruin at our last filing have risen again, and the ledger now counts 283 Colonial works to 153 Warden, none demolished. Stlican Shelf leads all regions with sixty recorded actions in the day, its Warden sixth and Colonial third works rebuilt even as Breaker Town, The Pale House and The Old Mourn change hands repeatedly; reports there are scarce a half-hour old. The Weathered Expanse, second at fifty-nine events, has hardened to six Warden works against three Colonial, and Stonecradle shows the same count after losses mounting near 4,300 Colonial and 4,500 Warden. Callahan's Passage, silent for more than three hours, still bears the war's heaviest toll — near 6,750 Colonial and 5,660 Warden casualties in the day about The Latch, its ten works yet Warden-held — while Farranac Coast's fire at Transient Valley, fresh within the half-hour, builds rapidly. Linn of Mercy has raised no flag for ten hours, yet its casualty rolls climb sharply; Marban Hollow and Viper Pit's Blackthroat quicken likewise. The Dead Lands has logged nothing since before dawn. It is day 215; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize, and neither side is named victor.
